summaries.ja: 著者らは、量子ビットと量子モードのハイブリッドデバイス向けに(1+1)次元Yukawa理論の実時間散乱を定式化し、スタッガードフェルミオンをトラップイオンの内部状態に、スカラー場を集団運動モードに符号化することでYukawa結合をネイティブなスピン依存変位とし、テンソルネットワークでデバイスをエミュレートして単一スカラー粒子の崩壊と共鳴領域付近のフェルミオン-反フェルミオン散乱を調べ、1ループ自己エネルギーのDyson総和を超える補正を分解できることを示した。

title: Zero mode, Zero influence: Spatial-derivative coupling in particle detectors
abstract: It is common in particle detector models in cavity QED to often omit zero modes or assume their state, compromising causality or introducing ambiguity in their predictions. We show that spatial-derivative coupling eliminates both problems. For free massless scalar fields in static periodic or Neumann cavities of any spatial dimension, cavity-frame spatial derivatives annihilate the zero-mode operator while preserving microcausality. Detector dynamics and entanglement harvesting then depend only on the reduced detector-oscillator state, nonperturbatively and even with initial correlations with the zero mode. Time derivatives and moving-detector rest-frame spatial derivatives can retain zero-mode state dependence not compromising causality. Realized through current coupling in superconducting circuits, spatial-derivative coupling thus makes zero-mode state assumptions unnecessary.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; General Relativity and Quantum Cosmology (gr-qc); High Energy Physics - Theory (hep-th)

summaries.en: Spatial-derivative coupling in particle detector models annihilates the zero-mode operator for free massless scalar fields in static periodic or Neumann cavities of any dimension while preserving microcausality, so detector dynamics and entanglement harvesting depend only on the reduced detector-oscillator state even with initial zero-mode correlations, making zero-mode state assumptions unnecessary.
summaries.zh: 在粒子探测器模型中，空间导数耦合会在任意维度的静态周期或诺伊曼腔中对自由无质量标量场湮灭零模算符并保持微观因果性，因此探测器动力学和纠缠收获仅依赖于约化的探测器-振子态，即使存在初始零模关联也是如此，从而无需对零模状态作假设。
summaries.ja: 粒子検出器模型における空間微分結合は、任意次元の静的周期腔またはノイマン腔中の自由無質量スカラー場に対してゼロモード演算子を消滅させつつ微視的因果性を保つため、検出器ダイナミクスとエンタングルメント収穫は初期ゼロモード相関があっても縮約された検出器-振動子状態のみに依存し、ゼロモード状態の仮定を不要にする。

title: Optimal Estimation in Weak Value Amplification with a Position Pointer
abstract: We experimentally evaluate five estimators for weak-value amplification (WVA) using a position pointer to measure birefringence time delays. Two general approaches are considered: measuring the position shift $\Delta x$ and measuring the probability change $\Delta P_w$ of successful postselection. Specifically, five estimators are investigated: CCD-detected fringe shift $\Delta x$, quadrant photodiode (PDQ) transversal voltage difference (XDIFF), and lock-in amplifier output phase $\eta$ (for $\Delta x$ measurement), as well as PDQ total output voltage (SUM) and CCD-detected average photon number $N_r$ (for $\Delta P_w$ measurement). The measurement precision is characterized by the Allan deviation over a range of input laser powers $P_0$. Generally, measuring the position shift $\Delta x$ yields higher precision than measuring the probability change $\Delta P_w$. At $P_0=0.5$~mW, corresponding to a laser-power-limited regime, direct measurement of the fringe displacement with the CCD achieves a minimum Allan deviation of $(5.30\pm0.10)\times10^{-3}$~as, approaching the corresponding photon-statistical Cramér--Rao bound (CRB). At $P_0=50$~mW, corresponding to a detector-limited regime, PDQ detection combined with lock-in demodulation provides the best precision, reaching $(1.80\pm0.06)\times10^{-3}$~as and remaining close to the corresponding CRB. These results demonstrate that the optimal readout depends on the available optical power, detector dynamic range, and technical noise, providing practical guidance for selecting readout strategies in high-precision WVA-based metrology.

summaries.en: Five estimators for weak-value amplification with a position pointer were compared experimentally, showing that measuring the position shift generally outperforms measuring the postselection probability change, with CCD fringe-shift detection approaching the photon-statistical Cramér–Rao bound at low laser power and quadrant-photodiode lock-in detection achieving the best precision at high power.
summaries.zh: 本文实验比较了基于位置指针的弱值放大中的五种估计器，发现测量位置偏移通常优于测量后选择成功概率变化，在低激光功率下CCD条纹位移检测接近光子统计Cramér–Rao界，而在高功率下四象限光电二极管结合锁相解调取得最佳精度。

title: Enhanced shortcuts to adiabaticity in an interacting giant-atom-atomic-waveguide system
abstract: In realistic quantum systems, isolated few-level models usually provide only an approximate description, since the controlled subsystem is generally coupled to additional degrees of freedom. As a result, a quantum control scheme designed for an isolated system may lose its original performance in a more complex coupled setting. Here, we consider a giant atom coupled to an interacting atomic waveguide and investigate enhanced shortcuts to adiabaticity (eSTA) in such a structured system. As a first step, a weak-coupling perturbative analysis identifies how changes in the initial and target states, together with dynamical transitions, contribute to the fidelity loss. Starting from a shortcut to adiabaticity control scheme for the uncoupled system, the enhanced STA correction improves the final fidelity by modifying only the giant-atom control fields. This improvement is found for both periodic and open boundary conditions of the atomic waveguide. The results demonstrate a way to design an eSTA protocol for an interacting composite system.

summaries.en: The paper investigates enhanced shortcuts to adiabaticity for a giant atom coupled to an interacting atomic waveguide, showing that weak-coupling perturbative analysis identifies the sources of fidelity loss and that correcting only the giant-atom control fields improves the final fidelity under both periodic and open boundary conditions.
summaries.zh: 本文研究了巨型原子与相互作用原子波导耦合系统中的增强绝热捷径，通过弱耦合微扰分析识别保真度损失的来源，并证明仅修正巨型原子的控制场即可在周期和开放边界条件下提高最终保真度。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、相互作用する原子導波路に結合した巨大原子系における拡張断熱的捷径を研究し、弱結合摂動解析により忠実度損失の原因を特定するとともに、巨大原子の制御場のみを修正することで周期境界条件と開境界条件の両方で最終忠実度が向上することを示した。

title: Implications of the PXP ground-state sign structure for neural-network variational Monte Carlo
abstract: Positive-definite neural-network quantum states cannot directly represent the ground state of the PXP Hamiltonian, since the ground-state wavefunction carries a nontrivial relative-sign structure. Building on the chiral symmetry of the PXP Hamiltonian, we show that this sign structure is fixed exactly by the parity of the total up-spin number: a diagonal unitary transformation that assigns a sign to each spin configuration according to this parity maps the PXP Hamiltonian to its negative, rendering the transformed Hamiltonian stoquastic on the Rydberg-blockaded Hilbert space. Since the configuration graph of allowed configurations is connected, the Perron-Frobenius theorem guarantees a unique, strictly positive ground state of the transformed Hamiltonian, yielding an exact sign rule for the ground state of the original Hamiltonian in terms of the parity of the up-spin number. Variational Monte Carlo performed directly on the transformed Hamiltonian with a positive-definite ansatz therefore requires no architecture-specific modification to represent the true ground state. We evaluate the performance of this formulation using five representative neural-network quantum state architectures, SineKAN, reflection-symmetrized SineKAN, RBM, MLP, and LSTM, for different chain lengths.

summaries.en: Building on the chiral symmetry of the PXP Hamiltonian, the authors show that a parity-of-up-spin diagonal unitary transformation makes the Hamiltonian stoquastic with a unique strictly positive ground state, yielding an exact sign rule that lets positive-definite neural-network variational Monte Carlo represent the true ground state without architecture-specific modifications, as evaluated with SineKAN, reflection-symmetrized SineKAN, RBM, MLP, and LSTM for various chain lengths.
summaries.zh: 基于 PXP 哈密顿量的手征对称性，作者证明按总自旋向上数目的奇偶性施加的对角酉变换可将该哈密顿量映射为其负值，使其在里德堡阻塞希尔伯特空间上成为 stoquastic 的，从而由 Perron-Frobenius 定理保证唯一严格正的基态，并给出原哈密顿量基态的精确符号规则，使得正定神经网络变分蒙特卡罗无需针对特定架构修改即可表示真实基态，并用 SineKAN、反射对称化 SineKAN、RBM、MLP 和 LSTM 在不同链长下进行了评估。
summaries.ja: PXPハミルトニアンのカイラル対称性に基づき、全上向きスピン数の偶奇に応じた対角ユニタリ変換がハミルトニアンをその負に写像してリュードベリ遮断ヒルベルト空間上でstoquasticにし、Perron-Frobenius定理により唯一の厳密に正の基底状態が保証されることで、元のハミルトニアンの基底状態に対する厳密な符号規則が得られ、正定値のニューラルネットワーク変分モンテカルロがアーキテクチャ固有の変更なしに真の基底状態を表現できることを示し、SineKAN、反射対称化SineKAN、RBM、MLP、LSTMを用いて異なる鎖長で評価した。

title: Discovering Models for Experimental Quantum Systems with Agentic AI
abstract: A central obstacle in realizing color center cavity-QED-based quantum technologies is inhomogeneity, or disorder, among individual emitters. As the number of emitters increases, so does the complexity of the experimental data, making it difficult to quantify the present physical mechanisms of disorder. Here we introduce an artificial intelligence-driven model discovery framework in which a large language model (LLM)-based agent, equipped with tools and a structured workflow, proposes candidate Hamiltonian and Lindbladian models, generates computational tools, and quantitatively evaluates competing physical hypotheses. We apply the workflow to three previously published experimental cavity-QED datasets collected from color centers in diamond and silicon carbide. Across the experiments, the agent successfully identifies physical models for the system and characterizes the disorder. In assessing reproducibility, we find that run-to-run variability is concentrated primarily in the research plan generation step, while the computational analysis itself is substantially more consistent. Our results suggest that structured LLM agent workflows can support model discovery from quantum optical experimental data while simultaneously allowing for human expert supervision and collaboration.

summaries.en: A structured LLM-based agentic AI framework proposes and quantitatively evaluates candidate Hamiltonian and Lindbladian models, thereby identifying physical models and characterizing emitter disorder in three previously published color-center cavity-QED datasets from diamond and silicon carbide.
summaries.zh: 一种基于大语言模型的结构化智能体框架能够提出并定量评估候选哈密顿量与林德布拉德模型，从而在三个已发表的、来自金刚石和碳化硅色心的腔QED实验数据集上识别物理模型并表征发射体无序。
summaries.ja: 構造化されたLLMベースのエージェント型AIフレームワークが候補ハミルトニアンおよびリンドブラッドモデルを提案・定量的に評価し、ダイヤモンドと炭化ケイ素の色中心キャビティQEDに関する既発表の3つの実験データセットにおいて物理モデルを同定し発光体の無秩序を特徴付けた。

title: Photon-loss tolerance of the surface-GKP code with anti-photon-loss decoding
abstract: Photon loss somewhat limits fault-tolerant photonic quantum computing. We investigate its effect on finite-energy Gottesman--Kitaev--Preskill (GKP) states by modeling the pure-loss channel directly. We obtain photon-loss threshold estimates for the surface-GKP code using nearest-lattice-point inner GKP decoding and minimum-weight perfect matching for the outer surface code. For GKP states with $\epsilon=0.01$ and $\epsilon=0.05$, corresponding to GKP squeezing of $20$ and $13\,\mathrm{dB}$, the estimated thresholds are $\gamma^\ast=5.5\%$ ($0.24\,\mathrm{dB}$) and $\gamma^\ast=5.9\%$ ($0.26\,\mathrm{dB}$), respectively. We then introduce an anti-photon-loss inner decoder that compensates for the contraction of the measured quadrature. It increases the corresponding threshold estimates to $\gamma^\ast=9.8\%$ ($0.45\,\mathrm{dB}$) and $\gamma^\ast=6.3\%$ ($0.28\,\mathrm{dB}$). Our results highlight the importance of accounting for loss-induced lattice contraction in inner decoding and demonstrate that quadrature compensation enhances the photon-loss tolerance of surface-GKP codes for both high- and moderate-quality GKP states, providing a route toward more photon-loss-robust optical quantum computing.

summaries.en: By modeling the pure-loss channel directly for finite-energy GKP states, the authors estimate surface-GKP code photon-loss thresholds of 5.
summaries.zh: 通过直接对有限能量GKP态建模纯损耗信道，作者估计出在GKP压缩分别为20 dB和13 dB时表面-GKP码的光子损耗阈值分别为5.

title: Single-Mode Squeezing Using Degenerate Four-Wave Mixing in a Dual-Pump TWPA
abstract: Single-mode squeezing of the electromagnetic vacuum is a key resource for mode-selective noise reduction in quantum measurements. At microwave frequencies, single-mode squeezing is typically obtained by using Josephson and Traveling-Wave Parametric Amplifiers designed for three-wave mixing operation. In single-pump degenerate four-wave mixing, the coincidence of pump, signal, and idler frequencies complicates separation of the squeezed field from the strong pump. A dual-pump configuration enables degenerate operation while keeping both pumps spectrally separated from the squeezed mode. Here, we demonstrate single-mode squeezing in a flux-tunable, dual-pump Traveling-Wave Parametric Amplifier, employing reversed-Kerr phase matching. By independently calibrating the single-pump gains, we find that the strongest squeezing occurs along approximately balanced-gain trajectories, while the optimal squeezing does not necessarily correspond to the highest dual-pump gain. At flux biases $\Phi_\mathrm{ext}/\Phi_0 = 0.0$ and $0.5$, the minimum quadrature noise levels reach $-2.48 \pm 0.18~\mathrm{dB}$ and $-1.62 \pm 0.20~\mathrm{dB}$ relative to vacuum, respectively. These results establish the proposed architecture as a platform for single-mode squeezing in microwave continuous-variable quantum technologies.

summaries.en: A flux-tunable dual-pump traveling-wave parametric amplifier using degenerate four-wave mixing with reversed-Kerr phase matching achieves single-mode vacuum squeezing of up to -2.

title: All-to-All Connectivity in Superconducting Qubits via Metamaterial-Mediated Interactions
abstract: We show that encoding superconducting qubits as dual-rail or spin-locked transmons lets a metamaterial waveguide couple them all-to-all while suppressing the spurious entanglement that burdens shared-mode architectures, a step toward the non-local connectivity that quantum low-density parity-check codes require. In a bare-transmon architecture, the dispersive coupling between each populated mode and every idle qubit attached to it entangles spectators with the gate, and cancelling it by dynamical decoupling lengthens every gate. The encoding suppresses this coupling at the hardware level, from second to fourth order in the inverse qubit--mode detuning. A two-tone cross-resonance drive then generates a Mølmer-Sørensen interaction between encoded qubits, which we use for an entangling gate and a joint parity measurement, both selective and parallelizable through different modes. Simulating two dual-rail transmons sharing three resonators with a mode lifetime of $30\,\mu$s, we find that heralding transmon relaxation as erasure leaves a gate infidelity of $1.4\times10^{-3}$ at $152$~ns, dominated by photon loss. Photon loss and mode crowding together bound the array size. The gate duration must exceed the inverse mode spacing, which shrinks as the array lengthens, while photon loss grows with gate duration. This bound grows linearly with the mode lifetime and with the inter-resonator coupling; at a lifetime of $150\,\mu$s, five times the simulated value, and a coupling of $80$~MHz, a $10^{-3}$ error budget admits $13$ qubits on $25$ resonators.

summaries.en: Encoding superconducting qubits as dual-rail or spin-locked transmons allows a metamaterial waveguide to couple them all-to-all while suppressing spurious spectator entanglement at the hardware level, enabling a Mølmer-Sørensen entangling gate and joint parity measurement with simulated infidelity of 1.
summaries.zh: 将超导量子比特编码为双轨或自旋锁定transmon，可使超材料波导实现全连接耦合并在硬件层面抑制寄生旁观者纠缠，从而支持Mølmer-Sørensen纠缠门和联合宇称测量，模拟中在152纳秒处达到1.

title: Pump-scheme dependence of few-emitter lasers: exact multilevel correlations and photon statistics
abstract: Few-emitter laser models usually replace the excitation cycle of the gain medium by a single Markovian pump jump of a two-level emitter. We test this replacement with the cavity and laser-transition parameters held fixed and the two-level pump rate fitted to the same mean photon number, using an exact damping-basis continued-fraction solution of the cavity--emitter master equation for $N$ identical $d$-level emitters with arbitrary independent incoherent transitions and one cavity-coupled transition, in the known reduced space of level populations and lasing coherences. First, a pump-quantum filtration shows that the inter-emitter coherence of $\Lambda$ and ladder media starts at second rather than first order in the pump; we evaluate its leading coefficient from the exact finite-system series and map the recycling rate at which its sign changes. Second, at matched photon number, rate-limited steps in the pump cycle push the long-time output-counting Fano factor of two and three emitters well below one: for two emitters it reaches 0.66 at a mean cavity occupation of 0.3 and is still 0.74 at an occupation of one, where $g^{(2)}(0)$ is within 3% of unity, because the anticorrelation sits at delays of about half a cavity lifetime rather than at zero delay. For two and three emitters the fitted two-level model gets both statistics wrong and places the output above the shot-noise level. Against independent single-emitter lasers at the same output, the common cavity erodes rather than enhances this single-emitter effect.

title: Cooling-path-selected self-assembly of telecom InAsP quantum dots
abstract: Epitaxial quantum dots are leading solid-state sources of quantum light, but reproducible growth on indium phosphide (InP) remains challenging because dot-formation windows are narrow and emission wavelengths are difficult to predict. Here we report a new epitaxial route for InAsP quantum dots on InP(001), in which the cooling path selects the final morphology without intentional deposition of group-III dot material. High-temperature As exposure forms a shallow near-surface InAsP layer through As-P exchange; the cooling path and continued As supply determine whether three-dimensional islands form. Surface-sensitive spectroscopy shows near-surface As enrichment, while cross-sectional STEM/EELS identifies graded, As-rich InAsP islands. The capped emitters span 1.2-1.6 micrometers, with single-photon emission observed up to 100 K. Across 20 wafers, the surface-effective exchange dose D provides a practical calibration for targeting the median emission wavelength. These results establish cooling as an active epitaxial step for telecom InAsP quantum-dot formation and wavelength control.

title: Boson sampling is fragile to loss
abstract: Boson sampling experiments aim to demonstrate quantum computational advantage with increasing numbers of interfering photons. A central question is whether their computational hardness survives under photon loss. We show that even an arbitrarily small nonzero uniform loss rate permits efficient classical sampling in the average case when the rate remains fixed as the system grows. We exploit how loss suppresses correlations involving many photons to approximate the full output distribution using low correlation orders. The resulting samplers run in time polynomial in system size and inverse total variation error, with the error averaged over Haar random interferometers. The results apply to Fock state boson sampling with single-photon states in distinct input modes and arbitrary additional vacuum inputs, and to Gaussian boson sampling with equal squeezing of bounded strength in every input mode. Classical sampling is efficient even when the mean detected photon number grows linearly with system size, showing that large photon counts alone do not ensure computational hardness.

summaries.en: This paper shows that boson sampling becomes efficiently classically simulable in the average case under any fixed nonzero uniform photon loss rate, because loss suppresses high-order photon correlations.

title: Near-Optimal Learning of Quantum Many-Body Systems from Gibbs and Thermal Metastable States via the Stationarity Test
abstract: We study the problem of learning a finite-range quantum Hamiltonian on an $n$-qubit $D$-dimensional lattice from copies of its Gibbs states at a known inverse temperature $\beta$ or its thermal metastable states. Existing efficient algorithms at arbitrary temperature have sample guarantees with an $e^{\poly(\beta)}$ dependence, leaving open whether the exponent can be made linear in $\beta$. We achieve this improvement: for $\beta\ge1$, our algorithm learns all Hamiltonian coefficients to $\ell_\infty$-error $\epsilon$ with probability at least $1-\delta$ using $\tO\bigl(e^{O(\beta)}\epsilon^{-2}\log(n/\delta)\bigr)$ copies and total time $\tO\bigl(n e^{O(\beta)}\epsilon^{-2}\log(n/\delta)\bigr)$. The measurements act on individual copies and are supported on balls of radius $O\bigl(\beta^2+\beta\log(1/\epsilon)\bigr)$. Our sample complexity achieves the optimal exponential order in $\beta$, with optimal $\epsilon^{-2}$ dependence up to logarithmic factors. Building on the stationarity-test framework \citep{Bergamaschi2026Stationarity}, we prove a unified Fisher-information coercivity bound showing that errors in the candidate Hamiltonian produce a detectable signal with only an $e^{-O(\beta)}$ loss in sensitivity. The key is a smooth frequency filter whose bandwidth remains independent of temperature, together with sharper estimates relating this signal to the Hamiltonian coefficients. For thermal metastable states, the guarantee holds under local drift $\zeta\le e^{-C\beta^{2D+1}}$, for a geometry-dependent constant $C>0$, and above an accuracy floor $\tO(e^{O(\beta)}\zeta)$. The argument applies to both Gibbs and thermal metastable states and, combined with local measurements and projected stochastic gradient descent (SGD), yields both learning guarantees.

summaries.en: A new algorithm learns all coefficients of a finite-range quantum Hamiltonian on an n-qubit lattice from Gibbs or thermal metastable states to ℓ∞-error ε with high probability using Õ(e^{O(β)}ε^{-2}log(n/δ)) copies and near-linear time, achieving the optimal exponential order in β and optimal ε^{-2} dependence via a unified Fisher-information coercivity bound built on the stationarity-test framework.

title: Bounds and sufficient conditions in quantum Zeno effect
abstract: When a quantum system undergoes a series of repeated measurements during its time evolution to check whether it remains in the initial state, the resulting state lifetime can decrease (the quantum Zeno effect) or increase (the quantum inverse Zeno effect) as the inter-measurement period increases. Several transitions between these two regimes may occur within the same system. A carefully chosen measurement period $\tau_\ast$ (or rate $r_\ast$ in the case of a stochastic measurement protocol) brings the state lifetime to its global minimum. Here, we describe the upper and lower bounds on the optimized state lifetime, which are expressed in terms of characteristic time scales encoded in the state survival probability $P(T)$, which is assumed to decrease monotonically to zero at large $T$. In addition, we analyze the bounds on the optimal measurement periods/rates and formulate sufficient conditions for observing the inverse Zeno effect. The analysis is also extended to states with non-monotonic survival functions. The results are illustrated numerically with an example of a system of optically trapped ultra-cold atoms.

summaries.en: The paper derives upper and lower bounds on the optimized state lifetime in repeated-measurement quantum Zeno and inverse Zeno protocols, expresses them in terms of characteristic time scales of the monotonically decaying survival probability, and gives bounds on optimal measurement periods or rates plus sufficient conditions for the inverse Zeno effect, extending the analysis to non-monotonic survival functions and illustrating it with optically trapped ultracold atoms.

title: Seeing Why: Exact Evidence Maps for Quantum and Optical Image Classifiers
abstract: When an image classifier decides, we can usually only estimate why. For quantum and all-optical classifiers that act linearly on amplitude-encoded pictures up to the measurement, with no trained classical network before or after them, the decomposition needs no approximation: each class's probability above its no-information share splits exactly into contributions of the encoded amplitudes, shown as Born evidence maps (BEM) over the picture and measurable on the hardware that classifies. For the quadratic form behind each class probability it equals Integrated Gradients from a zero baseline, in closed form. Deleting the 5 % of pixels with the highest evidence drops accuracy from 73 % to 9 %, as occlusion does with 1,024 extra runs per picture, whereas gradient saliency removes much less. One architecture serves both: a Fourier-plane mask followed by a brickwall circuit on qubits or by phase plates on a lens bench, read by a Born headroom readout with no trained parameter; centring each picture on its own mean lets dark features count as much as bright ones. In simulation, four phase plates at a single wavelength reach 72.3 % on Caltech-10 colour photographs (96.8 % on MNIST, 86.7 % on Fashion-MNIST, 47.9 % on colour CIFAR-10). On IBM's ibm_kingston, with the mask applied before approximate loading, 300 Caltech-10 test pictures were classified at 37.7 % against 10 % by chance (56.3 % in exact simulation), and 2x2 maps of ten correctly and confidently classified pictures, estimated on the chip, agreed with the exact ones (r = 0.77). The maps also revealed a shortcut in the data.

summaries.en: Quantum and all-optical linear image classifiers acting on amplitude-encoded pictures admit exact, closed-form Born evidence maps that equal integrated gradients from a zero baseline and can be measured on the classifying hardware.

title: From Fabrication Disorder to Quantum-Protocol Yield in Inverse-Designed Silicon Photonic Beam Splitters
abstract: Telecom-band silicon spin-photon qubits offer a promising platform for scalable quantum networks and distributed information processing, but their fixed emission wavelengths require compact, low-loss beam splitters with precise splitting and fabrication robustness. Conventional designs can face trade-offs between footprint, optical performance, and wavelength-specific operation. Here, we employ adjoint-based inverse design to optimize photonic geometries beyond conventional layouts, developing 1*2 Y-splitters and 2*2 directional couplers for the silicon T (1326 nm) and Al1 (1482.44 nm) spin-photon qubits. The devices achieve footprints of 2.9 and 26 um^2, respectively, with excess losses of 0.14-0.44 dB and back-reflection below 5*10^-4. We assess fabrication tolerance using 100-realization Monte Carlo simulations incorporating etch bias, line-edge roughness, thickness, and refractive-index variations. Mirror symmetry reduces the splitting-ratio spread of the Y-splitter by a factor of seven to nine relative to the directional coupler. We translate these variations into dual-rail fidelity, ideal splitting-ratio-limited Hong-Ou-Mandel visibility, and random-number min-entropy. All realizations satisfy a protocol-performance threshold of 0.95. At 0.99, the tolerated splitting-ratio deviation shrinks from 0.035 for visibility to 0.0035 for min-entropy, and the simulated yields are 68% (T) and 91% (Al1) for coupler visibility and 90% (T) and 66% (Al1) for Y-splitter min-entropy. The tolerance of the target protocol, rather than the device alone, therefore sets the fabrication requirement for silicon spin-photon beam splitters.

summaries.en: Using adjoint-based inverse design, this study develops compact, low-loss silicon photonic Y-splitters and directional couplers for telecom-band spin-photon qubits, and Monte Carlo simulations show that fabrication-induced splitting-ratio variations translate into quantum-protocol fidelities, Hong-Ou-Mandel visibilities, and random-number min-entropy whose tolerance requirements—rather than device metrics alone—set the fabrication yield.

title: Performance analysis of cat and GKP breeding protocols with squeezed single-photon input
abstract: Homodyne breeding is a promising optical route for generating large cat states and Gottesman--Kitaev--Preskill (GKP) grid states, using readily available squeezed-cat states as inputs. We analyze the performance of protocols, using squeezed single-photon seeds, $\hat{S}(r)\ket{1}$, as squeezed-cat resources and propagating them through the same cat-to-GKP breeding pipeline. For a symmetric tree with $N=2^{m_1}$ seeds, the heralded resource state reduces to a state with a polynomial-Gaussian wavefunction controlled by a single effective width, achieving near-unit fidelity with the desired cat resource state. Our analysis yields closed-form even-cat fidelities and an inverse-design rule for the seed squeezing. We apply these resources to GKP breeding, and find a large overlap with a practical GKP state. We also investigate the effects of practical imperfections, including finite homodyne acceptance windows and photon loss. This study shows that squeezed single-photon inputs provide a viable resource assignment for homodyne cat and GKP breeding, replacing the demanding requirement for high-resolution photon-number-resolving heralding with an on-demand single-photon source.

summaries.en: The paper analyzes homodyne breeding protocols for cat and GKP states using squeezed single-photon seeds S(r)|1>, showing that symmetric trees of 2^m1 seeds yield near-unit-fidelity cat resources with closed-form even-cat fidelities and an inverse-design rule for seed squeezing, that these resources overlap well with practical GKP states, and that performance under finite acceptance windows and photon loss makes squeezed single-photon inputs a viable alternative to photon-number-resolving heralding.

title: Inducing cooperative dynamics in an inhomogeneous many-emitter ensemble with a pulse sequence
abstract: Driving a many-particle quantum system with an appropriately tuned external field can give rise to features in its nonequilibrium dynamics that are absent in the equilibrium counterpart. Cooperative dynamics in a dense ensemble of quantum emitters manifested through superradiance, a burst in the emission intensity as a function of time, is typically suppressed by spectral disparities among emitters in the ensemble. We demonstrate the enhancement of cooperative dynamics in a spectrally inhomogeneous ensemble of quantum emitters when it is driven by a periodic pulse sequence. Using both a semi-analytical mean-field solution and a digital quantum simulation, we examine the coherence of the pulse-driven ensemble and the intensity of the emitted radiation as a function of the spectral disparity in the ensemble, as a function of time, the number of atoms in the system, and as a function of the inter-pulse delay. We identify clear signatures of the enhanced cooperative dynamics for the pulse-driven inhomogeneous ensemble when dephasing in the dynamics of the ensemble is suppressed by a sufficient number of pulses during the individual emitter lifetime. These results demonstrate a post-fabrication tuning knob based on externally applied control fields for the dynamics of the many-emitter ensemble.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall); Atomic Physics (physics.atom-ph); Optics (physics.optics)

title: Needle-beam generation from SPDC photons using inverse-designed flat optics
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the generation of needle-like beams from spontaneous parametric downconversion (SPDC) light using a compact inverse-designed multilevel diffractive lens (MDL). The nonclassical nature of the SPDC source is independently verified through a three-detector heralded Hanbury Brown-Twiss measurement performed before the MDL, yielding a zero-delay second-order correlation value of approximately 0.14. Spatial measurements using an intensified charge-coupled device reveal that the MDL maintains a tightly confined focal distribution over an axial distance of approximately 11 mm under collinear SPDC illumination, substantially reducing diffraction-induced broadening compared with a conventional plano-convex lens of the same nominal focal length. Under non-collinear SPDC illumination, two distinct regions of extended axial confinement are observed, demonstrating the dependence of the engineered focal distribution on the incident spatial field. These results establish a compact flat-optical approach for engineering extended-focus SPDC photon fields, with potential applications in structured quantum photonics.

title: Nonreciprocal generation of Bell states via cooperative dissipation in a qubit-magnon system
abstract: Directionally generating and controlling quantum states is critical in chiral quantum technologies. Here, we propose a scheme for the nonreciprocal generation of Bell states via cooperative dissipation in a qubit-magnon system, consisting of a superconducting transmon qubit and a yttrium iron garnet sphere subject to a bias magnetic field. The cooperative dissipation between them is induced by coupling both to a common transmission-line waveguide. Due to this cooperative dissipation, the system possesses a dark eigenstate within the single-excitation subspace. Under appropriate parameter conditions, the dark eigenstate reduces to a specific Bell state. With the assistance of a drive pulse, the system can be prepared in this Bell state (i.e., the dark eigenstate). In particular, we find that the dark eigenstate corresponds to different Bell states under positive ($+\mathbf{B}_0$) and negative ($-\mathbf{B}_0$) bias fields. Consequently, nonreciprocal Bell-state generation is achieved: $+\mathbf{B}_0$ yields one Bell state, while $-\mathbf{B}_0$ yields the other. Moreover, we define a fidelity-based nonreciprocal rate to quantify this nonreciprocity. Our work establishes cooperative dissipation as a versatile resource for nonreciprocal entangled-state generation, opening a promising route toward chiral quantum technologies.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a scheme for nonreciprocal generation of Bell states via cooperative dissipation in a qubit-magnon system, where the dark eigenstate of the single-excitation subspace reduces to different Bell states under positive and negative bias magnetic fields, enabling direction-dependent entangled-state generation quantified by a fidelity-based nonreciprocal rate.

title: Taming a macroscopic free mass through continuous quantum measurement
abstract: The free particle is the most elementary dynamical system in quantum mechanics. Despite remarkable progress in quantum control of increasingly massive solid-state mechanical oscillators, the analogous control of the free-particle counterpart has remained elusive. Dissipation and environmental noise have prevented such control in the inherently low-frequency domain of free-particle dynamics---a regime of growing importance for quantum sensing and tests of fundamental physics. Here we realize a suspended 1-milligram rotor operating in the free-particle regime with exceptional environmental isolation. Combining this isolation with a low-noise measurement architecture, we directly resolve thermal fluctuations in the motion associated with a damping rate of only 7~nHz. Through continuous quantum measurement of the rotor, we localize its otherwise unconfined motion, obtaining conditional states with entropic temperatures as low as 140~nK as a quantitative measure of control in the free-particle regime. This is two orders of magnitude below temperatures previously achieved in tabletop optomechanical experiments. We demonstrate immediate utilities of the new operating regime, setting new constraints on modifications of quantum mechanics and benchmarking inferred entanglement-to-decoherence rate ratios nearly two orders of magnitude beyond the state of the art for tests of gravity at the quantum-classical interface.

summaries.en: By continuously measuring a suspended 1-milligram rotor in the free-particle regime with unprecedented isolation, the authors localize its motion to conditional states with entropic temperatures as low as 140 nK, enabling new constraints on modifications of quantum mechanics and improved benchmarks for quantum-classical gravity tests.

title: Quartet state of the neutral nitrogen-vacancy center in diamond and optimized spin readout under near-infrared two-photon excitation
abstract: Photoionization of the excited nitrogen-vacancy center (NV-) in diamond leaves the neutral defect in a metastable quartet state of unknown energy. Using two-photon optically detected magnetic resonance with a tunable femtosecond laser, we resolve its onset in the spin contrast at 1.23 +/- 0.02 eV and, with the ground-state threshold from the same setup, place the quartet 0.54 +/- 0.04 eV above the neutral ground state. The threshold sets the optimum excitation for spin readout at 1060-1075 nm, in the near-infrared tissue window, with 26-37% higher shot-noise-limited sensitivity than at 1030-1040 nm.

summaries.en: Using two-photon optically detected magnetic resonance with a tunable femtosecond laser, the neutral nitrogen-vacancy center's metastable quartet state is placed 0.
summaries.zh: 利用可调谐飞秒激光的双光子光探测磁共振，研究者将中性氮-空位色心的亚稳态四重态定位在基态之上0.
summaries.ja: 波長可変フェムト秒レーザーを用いた二光子光検出磁気共鳴により、中性窒素-空孔中心の準安定四重項状態は基底状態より0.

title: Service-Area Robust NOMA for Pinching Antennas Systems
abstract: Pinching-antenna systems (PASS) enable near-field beam focusing using radiating points along a dielectric waveguide, but coherent spherical-wave superposition makes their channels sensitive to small user displacements. This sensitivity is critical for power-domain non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA), where successive interference cancellation (SIC) requires the weak-user layer to remain decodable at the strong user. We develop spatially robust PASS-NOMA designs that optimize antenna placement and power splitting over bounded service areas (SAs), with a preset decoding order and explicit SIC-feasibility constraints. We propose a worst-case design for quasi-static users and an ergodic design for codewords spanning representative SA positions, and characterize their achievable rate regions. Numerical results show that, despite SIC requiring weak-user decoding in both SAs, NOMA outperforms orthogonal multiple access (OMA) with a shared placement under both robustness models except when the strong user is served at low rate. In the ergodic regime, this advantage can persist even against OMA with per-user antenna reconfiguration.

summaries.en: This paper develops spatially robust pinching-antenna-system (PASS) NOMA designs that optimize antenna placement and power splitting over bounded service areas with explicit SIC-feasibility constraints, proposing worst-case and ergodic formulations and showing that NOMA generally outperforms OMA with shared placement except at low strong-user rates.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了空间鲁棒的空心天线系统（PASS）NOMA设计方案，在有界服务区内优化天线布置与功率分配并显式加入SIC可行性约束，分别构建了最坏情况与遍历性两种设计并刻画其可达速率区域，数值结果表明除强用户以低速率服务外，NOMA在共享布置下优于OMA。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、有界なサービスエリア上でアンテナ配置と電力分割を最適化しSIC実現可能性制約を明示的に課す空間ロバストなピンチングアンテナシステム（PASS）NOMA設計を提案し、最悪ケース設計とエルゴディック設計を定式化して達成可能レート領域を特徴づけ、強ユーザを低レートで服務する場合を除き共有配置のOMAよりNOMAが優れることを数値的に示した。

title: Harnessing Inter-Waveguide Evanescent Coupling in Pinching-Antenna Systems
abstract: In multi-waveguide pinching-antenna systems (PASS), waveguides are typically modeled as independent signal-transport paths. However, when dielectric waveguides are closely spaced, their evanescent electromagnetic fields overlap, allowing guided signals to exchange energy before radiation. While such inter-waveguide coupling is conventionally regarded as undesirable crosstalk, this paper reveals an opportunity to harness it as an additional analog beamforming resource. The key insight is that coupling, through its interaction with sequential signal extraction by distributed pinching antennas (PAs), can reshape coherent signal combining at the receivers without increasing the available signal power. Consequently, stronger coupling does not necessarily yield better performance; rather, the coupling-induced phase relationships determine whether the radiated signals combine constructively or destructively. To characterize and exploit this mechanism, we establish a physics-based end-to-end channel model, derive coupling-aware waveguide-spacing principles and achievable-rate bounds, and develop joint waveguide deployment, PA placement, and digital precoding algorithms for multi-hotspot communications. Numerical results demonstrate substantial sum-rate improvements over conventional fixed-deployment and optimized minimum-spacing PASS benchmarks. These findings establish inter-waveguide evanescent coupling as a new physical degree of freedom for PASS channel reconfiguration.

summaries.en: The paper shows that inter-waveguide evanescent coupling in multi-waveguide pinching-antenna systems, though conventionally treated as crosstalk, can be exploited as an additional analog beamforming resource that reshapes coherent signal combining at receivers, with physics-based channel modeling, coupling-aware waveguide-spacing principles, achievable-rate bounds, and joint waveguide deployment, pinching-antenna placement, and digital precoding algorithms yielding substantial sum-rate gains over conventional fixed-deployment and minimum-spacing benchmarks.
summaries.zh: 本文表明，在多波导pinching天线系统中，波导间的倏逝耦合虽然通常被视为串扰，但可以被用作额外的模拟波束成形资源来重塑接收端的相干信号合并；为此作者建立了基于物理的端到端信道模型，推导了考虑耦合的波导间距原则与可达速率界，并针对多热点通信提出了波导部署、pinching天线放置与数字预编码的联合算法，相较传统固定部署和最小间距基准显著提升了总速率。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、マルチ導波路ピンチングアンテナシステムにおける導波路間のエバネッセント結合が、従来クロストークとして扱われてきたものの、受信機でのコヒーレント信号合成を再形成する追加のアナログビームフォーミング資源として活用できることを示し、物理に基づく端末間チャネルモデルの構築、結合を考慮した導波路間隔の原理と達成可能レートの界の導出、ならびにマルチホットスポット通信のための導波路配置・ピンチングアンテナ配置・デジタルプリコーディングの統合アルゴリズムの開発を通じて、従来の固定配置および最小間隔のベンチマークに対して大幅な合計レート改善を達成している。

title: Channel Estimation for Stacked Intelligent Metasurfaces with Mutual Coupling
abstract: Channel estimation for stacked intelligent metasurfaces (SIMs) has relied on the cascade model, which ignores mutual coupling and inter-layer reflection. Under a coupling-consistent multiport model, we show that the pilots are linear in the unknown channel segments and derive least-squares and linear minimum-mean-square-error estimators, an identifiability condition and an exact error decomposition for the reactance training schedule, and a gradient-based schedule design. Cascade-based estimation floors above $0$~dB normalized error at practical layer spacings and collapses the sum rate below that of the bare feed, whereas the proposed estimators retain about $80\%$ of the perfect-channel-knowledge sum rate.

summaries.en: Under a coupling-consistent multiport model for stacked intelligent metasurfaces (SIMs), the pilots are shown to be linear in the unknown channel segments, enabling least-squares and linear minimum-mean-square-error estimators with an identifiability condition and exact error decomposition for reactance training, which retain about 80% of perfect-channel-knowledge sum rate where cascade-based estimation collapses below the bare feed.
summaries.zh: 在考虑互耦与层间反射的耦合一致多端口模型下，堆叠智能超表面（SIM）的导频被证明是未知信道分段的线性函数，据此导出了最小二乘与线性最小均方误差估计器、可辨识条件、电抗训练方案的精确误差分解以及基于梯度的方案设计，所提估计器可保持约80%的理想信道知识总速率，而基于级联模型的估计在实际层间距下性能崩塌至低于裸馈源。
summaries.ja: 相互結合と層間反射を考慮した結合整合マルチポートモデルの下で、積層型インテリジェントメタサーフェス（SIM）のパイロットが未知のチャネルセグメントに対して線形であることを示し、最小二乗推定器と線形最小平均二乗誤差推定器、可同定性条件、リアクタンス訓練スケジュールの厳密な誤差分解、および勾配に基づくスケジュール設計を導出し、提案推定器は完全チャネル知識時の約80%の合計レートを維持する一方、実際的な層間隔ではカスケードモデルに基づく推定が裸のフィード以下まで崩壊することを示した。

title: Trajectory Design and User Scheduling for Pinching-Antenna Systems
abstract: Finite antenna movement speed introduces repositioning delays that can limit the performance gains of pinching-antenna systems. In this paper, a trajectory based scheme is proposed for a time division multiple access (TDMA) based pinching-antenna system, allowing transmission during both movement and stationary operation. A discrete-time model is developed to characterize periodic antenna trajectories and antenna-user service association under practical movement constraints. For a single-waveguide scenario, the expected average achievable rate is derived. The rate loss relative to instantaneous positioning and the rate improvement over a fixed antenna are further analyzed, with an upper bound on the former and a lower bound on the latter established. To improve fairness among users, a minimum average rate maximization problem is formulated through joint trajectory design and user scheduling. To address the coupling between these variables, an alternating optimization (AO) framework is adopted. Specifically, a successive convex approximation (SCA) based algorithm is developed using concave rate lower bounds, while a game based scheduling algorithm employs an ordered user-rate vector as the common utility. The convergence of the SCA objective value and the finite termination and stability of the scheduling algorithm are established. Simulation results demonstrate the gains achieved by the joint design and show that the proposed system can approach instantaneous-positioning performance under finite antenna movement speed.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a trajectory-based transmission and user-scheduling scheme for a TDMA pinching-antenna system that enables transmission during both antenna movement and stationary operation, deriving the average achievable rate with bounds on positioning loss and fixed-antenna gain and jointly optimizing trajectory and scheduling via alternating optimization to maximize the minimum average user rate.
summaries.zh: 本文针对基于时分多址的 pinch 天线系统提出一种轨迹式传输与用户调度方案，允许在天线移动和静止期间均进行传输，推导了平均可达速率及其相对瞬时定位的损失上界和相对固定天线的增益下界，并通过交替优化联合设计轨迹与调度以最大化最小平均用户速率。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、時分割多元接続を用いたピンチングアンテナシステムに対して、アンテナの移動中と静止中の両方で伝送を可能にする軌道ベースの伝送・ユーザスケジューリング方式を提案し、平均達成可能レートを導出するとともに瞬時配置に対する損失上界と固定アンテナに対する利得上界を明らかにし、交互最適化により軌道設計とスケジューリングを統合して最小平均ユーザレートを最大化する。

title: Distributed Pinching-Antenna Architecture for Communication and Target Positioning
abstract: We propose a pinching-antenna system (PASS)-assisted integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) framework for joint downlink communication and target positioning. The dielectric waveguides enable flexible signal radiation through activated pinching antennas (PAs), while the reflected echo signals are collected by a sensing receiver. A unified waveform is adopted to support both data transmission and sensing-echo processing. In particular, a two-stage procedure is developed for target localization using time-sum-of-arrival (TSoA) measurements, where the signal propagation distances are first estimated through de-chirp processing and beat frequency extraction. Then, the target position is obtained based on TSoA measurements using the weighted linear least squares(WLLS) technique. To characterize the fundamental limits of the PASS-assisted ISAC system, a Cramér-Rao lower bound (CRB) is derived, which captures the impact of PA activation. Furthermore, the PA activation problem is formulated to jointly optimize the communication spectral efficiency (SE) and sensing performance. To address this, a low-complexity heuristic greedy selection algorithm is proposed to determine the activated PA pattern. Numerical results demonstrate that the proposed scheme outperforms random PA selection, achieving gains of up to 81% improvement in communication SE.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a pinching-antenna system-assisted integrated sensing and communication framework that uses dielectric waveguides and activated pinching antennas for joint downlink communication and target positioning, with a two-stage TSoA-based localization procedure using de-chirp processing and weighted linear least squares, a derived Cramér-Rao lower bound, and a low-complexity greedy PA activation algorithm that achieves up to 81% communication spectral efficiency gain over random selection.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出了一种基于夹持天线系统的通感一体化框架，利用介质波导和激活的夹持天线实现联合下行通信与目标定位，采用基于到达时间和的两阶段定位方法（先通过去啁啾处理和拍频提取估计传播距离，再用加权线性最小二乘法求解目标位置），推导了刻画夹持天线激活影响的克拉美-罗下界，并提出低复杂度贪心选择算法优化夹持天线激活模式，使通信频谱效率相比随机选择提升最高81%。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、誘電体導波路と活性化されたピンチングアンテナを用いて下り通信と目標測位を統合するピンチングアンテナシステム支援の通信・センシング統合フレームワークを提案し、デチャープ処理とビート周波数抽出による伝搬距離推定と重み付き線形最小二乗法による到来時間和に基づく二段階測位、ピンチングアンテナ活性化の影響を捉えるクラメール・ラオ下限の導出、通信スペクトル効率とセンシング性能を同時最適化する低計算量の貪欲選択アルゴリズムを提示し、ランダム選択と比較して通信スペクトル効率が最大81%向上することを示す。

title: Task-driven sparse-view planar X-ray computed tomography for axial metrology
abstract: Computational imaging can reduce the acquisition burden when the system is designed around task-relevant information rather than complete image recovery. We investigate this framework for sparse-view planar X-ray tomography (XCT) of layered objects, using measurement of the axial termination gap (ATG) of back-drilled printed-circuit-board (PCB) vias as a representative task. Instead of using 3D reconstruction, the proposed method estimates ATG directly from polychromatic projection data through a physics-based sensitivity model. A gated hierarchical estimator first fits ATG together with radiometric perturbations and selectively introduces global geometry and specimen-warp models only when a reduced chi-squared adequacy test and Bayesian information criterion justify the added degrees of freedom. The same low-dimensional perturbation model is incorporated into marginalized Fisher-information analyses, yielding task-specific conditional and calibration-aware Cram'er-Rao bounds. Numerical experiments show that, under a fixed total photon budget, task-driven metrology changes little over 12-64 views, while reconstruction-driven metrology is strongly view-dependent with much larger errors. The direct estimator also follows the expected photon-limited scaling. These results demonstrate a computational sensing strategy in which XCT acquisition, physical modeling, and inference are evaluated according to the quantitative information required by the task rather than for general-purpose volumetric image fidelity.
subjects: Image and Video Processing (eess.IV) ; Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

summaries.en: A task-driven approach estimates the axial termination gap of back-drilled PCB vias directly from sparse-view polychromatic X-ray projection data using a physics-based sensitivity model with a gated hierarchical estimator, achieving view-count-insensitive, photon-limited performance that outperforms reconstruction-driven metrology under a fixed photon budget.
summaries.zh: 一种任务驱动方法利用基于物理的灵敏度模型和门控分层估计器，直接从稀疏视角多色X射线投影数据中估计背钻PCB过孔的轴向终止间隙，在固定光子预算下实现了对视角数量不敏感且受光子限制的性能，优于基于重建的计量方法。
summaries.ja: タスク駆動型手法は、物理ベースの感度モデルとゲート付き階層推定器を用いて、裏穴加工されたPCBビアの軸方向終端ギャップをスパースビューの多色X線投影データから直接推定し、固定光子予算下でビュー数に依存しない光子律速の性能を達成し、再構成駆動型計測を上回ることを示した。

title: Extended Field-of-View Passive mmWave Imaging Using Implicit Neural Representations
abstract: We introduce a self-supervised learning-based framework for expanding the field-of-view (FoV) of passive real-aperture millimeter wave (mmWave) imaging systems. Our framework exploits aliasing artifacts/grating lobes---which are an inherent part of mmWave image formation---to expand FoV. Specifically, we recognize that removing aliasing artifacts can be cast as an underdetermined deconvolution problem and that in solving this problem, one can expand the system's FoV. We solve this deconvolution problem and expand the system's FoV by enforcing temporal regularity with time-varying Implicit Neural Representations (INRs). We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach through extensive simulations and real-world experiments with Phase Sensitive Innovation's (PSI) state-of-the-art electro-optical modulation based passive mmWave imaging system.

summaries.en: This paper introduces a self-supervised learning framework that expands the field-of-view of passive real-aperture millimeter wave imaging systems by treating aliasing-artifact removal as an underdetermined deconvolution problem solved through time-varying implicit neural representations that enforce temporal regularity, validated by simulations and real-world experiments.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了一种自监督学习框架，通过将混叠伪影去除视为欠定反卷积问题，并利用施加时间正则化的时变隐式神经表示来求解该问题，从而扩展无源实孔径毫米波成像系统的视场，并通过大量仿真和真实实验验证了其有效性。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、エイリアシングアーティファクトの除去を劣決定逆畳み込み問題として捉え、時間的正則性を課す時変の暗黙的神経表現を用いてこれを解くことで、パッシブ実開口ミリ波イメージングシステムの視野を拡張する自己教師あり学習フレームワークを提案し、広範なシミュレーションと実世界実験によりその有効性を示した。

title: Multi-User Precoding with Stacked Intelligent Metasurfaces via Neural Reparameterization
abstract: Stacked intelligent metasurfaces (SIMs) enable wave-domain signal processing, and provide a promising architecture for enhancing spectral efficiency in multi-user wireless communication systems. However, jointly optimizing transmit power and multi-layer phase shifts in SIM-assisted wireless systems under quality-of-service (QoS) constraints results in a large-scale nonconvex problem, for which conventional numerical optimization-based methods, such as alternating optimization (AO), suffer from high computational burden and limited scalability. In this paper, we develop a QoS constraint-aware neural reparameterization framework for SIM-assisted downlink precoding. By embedding the cascaded wave-propagation structure of the SIM into a model-based differentiable architecture, both the phase shift configuration and transmit power allocation are reparameterized as parameters of a structured neural model that inherently satisfies feasibility constraints of the original problem. The resulting formulation enables efficient optimization that does not rely on a channel-to-precoding mapping learned through offline training. Instead, it directly updates the reparameterized optimization variables to realize real-time precoding for any channel realization. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior sum rate performance under QoS constraints, while significantly improving computational efficiency compared with conventional numerical optimization approaches.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a QoS constraint-aware neural reparameterization framework that embeds the cascaded wave-propagation structure of stacked intelligent metasurfaces into a model-based differentiable architecture, jointly optimizing phase shifts and transmit power for multi-user downlink precoding without offline training and with improved spectral efficiency and computational efficiency over conventional numerical optimization.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了一种感知服务质量约束的神经重参数化框架，将堆叠智能超表面的级联波传播结构嵌入基于模型的可微架构中，联合优化相移配置与发射功率以实现多用户下行预编码，无需离线训练即可获得优于传统数值优化方法的总速率性能和计算效率。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、積層型インテリジェントメタサーフェスの cascaded 波伝搬構造をモデルベースの微分可能アーキテクチャに埋め込み、位相シフト構成と送信電力を再パラメータ化して共同最適化するQoS制約対応のニューラル再パラメータ化フレームワークを提案し、オフライン学習を必要とせずに従来の数値最適化手法を上回る和レート性能と計算効率を実現する。
